source.title: n8n AI assitant is not capable of editing workflows

labels.description: Issue or PR is now in Linear

source.body: ## Describe the problem/error/question "n8n AI I have taken this out of another workflow, because i need to edit it to be just a one-time workflow to post a protocol from https://app.modjo.ai/call-details/147148 modjo call to https://app.notion.com/p/apaleo/Vesia-JLMW-AC-VESIA-40d04b9ee10b81e59dbac6fee1f04f1b notion page. Just once, then this will be deleted. Replace all calls logic to use the call and notion page from above instead of other's non existing modules. Show less Thinking A one-time, manually triggered workflow that fetches the transcript from Modjo call #147148, uses Claude AI to determine the call type and draft the appropriate protocol, then appends the formatted protocol blocks directly to the specified Notion page — with a confirmation email sent at the end. Trigger: Manually triggered once by clicking "Execute" — no schedule or webhook needed Hardcode the two key values — Modjo call ID 147148 and Notion page ID 40d04b9ee10b81e59dbac6fee1f04f1b — so all downstream steps reference them directly instead of pulling from a webhook or other modules. Fetch the full transcript for call #147148 from the Modjo API. Check the call title to decide whether this is a pre-certification call or a certification call, and route accordingly. Send the transcript to Claude AI to draft the appropriate protocol — either the pre-certification format or the certification format — depending on the branch. Transform the AI-generated protocol text into the Notion block structure required by the API. Append the formatted protocol blocks to the Notion page at https://app.notion.com/p/apaleo/Vesia-JLMW-AC-VESIA-40d04b9ee10b81e59dbac6fee1f04f1b. Send a confirmation email via Outlook once the protocol has been successfully posted to Notion. Notes The 'Log call processed' step (database insert) from the original workflow is removed — it's not needed for a one-time run. The two Anthropic branches (pre-cert and cert) merge before the Notion block builder, exactly as in the original workflow. After running once, the workflow can be deleted — no cleanup is needed on the n8n side. Version #1 (Current version) Implement the plan Looking at the approved plan, I need to: Add a manual trigger + Set node to hardcode call ID 147148 and Notion page ID Remove the webhook trigger and Find protocol page node references Remove the Log call processed step Wire everything together with the manual trigger Let me get the node type definitions I need. Thinking Getting node definitions" -- and this is where ai stops and doesn't do anything anymore. Workflow stays unchanged. If I ask to continue - it will forget all of the context an just start imagining his new instructions. ## What is the error message (if any)? n8n AI just does nothing when asked to edit a workflow. ## Please share your workflow/screenshots/recording [My workflow 67.json](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/34372549/My.workflow.67.json) ``` (Select the nodes on your canvas and use the keyboard shortcuts CMD+C/CTRL+C and CMD+V/CTRL+V to copy and paste the workflow.) ⚠️ WARNING ⚠️ If you have sensitive data in your workflow (like API keys), please remove it before sharing. ``` ## Share the output returned by the last node ## Debug info ### core - n8nVersion: 2.45.5 - platform: docker (cloud) - nodeJsVersion: 26.12.1 - nodeEnv: production - database: postgres - executionMode: scaling (single-main) - concurrency: 25 - license: enterprise (production) ### storage - success: all - error: all - progress: false - manual: true - binaryMode: filesystem ### pruning - enabled: true - maxAge: 720 hours - maxCount: 25000 executions ### client - userAgent: mozilla/5.0 (macintosh; intel mac os x 10_15_7) applewebkit/537.36 (khtml, like gecko) chrome/155.0.0.0 safari/537.36 - isTouchDevice: false Generated at: 2026-11-04T12:41:16.453Z
